selection.name: Call of the Wild
selection.description: The caster calls forth a Boar and a Hawk to aid in the battlefield.
selection.differences: Both Boar and Hawk are one spell.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Summons both Necro 3 units, Hawks gain Dive Bomb. When casted, all your summons gains 250 health.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Summons random dominated ancient creep, +2 Hawks spawned.

selection.name: Double Edge
selection.description: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Slows the movement speed and attack speed of enemies by 25% for 2s and increase caster's strength by 30% per, hero hit that lasts 15s. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of 5 stacks. Increases damage radius by 200 units.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: No longer deals self-damage. Grants 0.5% HP regen per stack.

selection.name: Dragon Slave
selection.description: The caster channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Deals 50 extra stacking damage for every unit hit. Increases damage by 150.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Spawns a Helm of the Overlord buffed Black Dragon where the spell ends.

selection.name: Duel
selection.description: The hero starts an epic duel against a target enemy hero, where both heroes are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items or abilities. If the casting hero's opponent dies during the Duel, the hero gains permanent bonus damage.
selection.differences:
Duel does not grant damage to enemies upon losing Duel.
Attack modifiers can be used while Dueling.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: +250 cast range, +10 bonus damage, +1 duration, and -20s cooldown.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Caster and opponent take 80% less damage from other sources.

selection.name: Earth Splitter
selection.description: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: +10% maximum health as damage, +75 effect width, -60s cooldown.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Enemies affected by Earth Splitter will also have 100% reduced base armor and 100% reduced magical resistance for the duration of the debuff.

selection.name: Earthshock
selection.description: The caster leaps forward 400 units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock that damages and slows all enemy units in a nearby area for 3 seconds.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Causes Earthshock to apply a 1.5 second Enrage buff on yourself. +500 radius.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: All other allied heroes perform an Earthshock that deals 50% of the original damage. Earthshocks created this way do not gain any bonuses from its Super.
